clock_model: single global clock; combinational paths are assumed to settle within one clock cycle
internal_visibility: attacker may correlate observed trace activity with any internal net's switching behavior, not just primary ports
review_focus: identify which internal nets carry values derived from partial products of the input shares
characterize how many clock cycles elapse between share inputs arriving and each net settling to its steady-state value
assess whether any single net's transient (pre-settling) activity could depend on signals derived from more than one share of the same operand within one clock cycle
notes: This review should treat combinational settling time as significant: gate delays and differing fan-in depths mean internal nodes do not necessarily reach their final value instantaneously or in lockstep. The report should account for both steady-state (settled) values and the transient activity that occurs while a combinational stage is still resolving within a clock cycle.
